opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers from the humanities and social sciences based at a UK university or recognised research organisation; UK citizens or EEA nationals; must hold a doctorate from a UK university; early‑career postdoctoral stage; must not hold a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year award supporting early‑career researchers to undertake independent research leading to a publishable output.

opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a permanent or fixed‑term position at a UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation; must lead an interdisciplinary project involving collaborators from different Academy remits.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding of up to 24 months for interdisciplinary research crossing humanities/social sciences, engineering and natural sciences.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers holding a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or independent research organisation, working in the humanities or social sciences; early‑career and mid‑/senior‑career researchers eligible.
opportunities.summary: Short‑term awards (6–12 months) to develop new skills (e.g., quantitative, data science, digital humanities) and support innovative research methods.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: up to £300,000 over 2 years (80% FEC, total project value up to £375,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a UK‑based humanities or social sciences researcher with an established role; must involve overseas co‑applicants; interdisciplinary collaboration across SHAPE and STEM disciplines required.
opportunities.summary: Two‑year interdisciplinary projects led by UK researchers, working with international partners on mobilities, funded up to £300,000.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑career or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences, based at a UK university or research organisation, to be based at DGAP in Berlin.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowship to develop policy‑relevant analysis in areas such as security, Indo‑European relations, technology, and strategy‑making, with up to £150,000 funding.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: up to £4,000 (higher amounts possible in exceptional cases)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support additional needs (e.g., equipment, caring costs, accessibility) for award‑holders or applicants, reviewed monthly.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers at any career stage in the humanities or social sciences, proposing a public engagement project with a GLAM or performing arts organisation.
opportunities.summary: Funding up to £8,000 for innovative public engagement projects delivering research to public audiences.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers affiliated with UK or German institutions in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Symposium attendance (travel, accommodation, visa covered) on ‘Humans and Nature’; seed funding available for post‑symposium collaborative projects.
